name: Vulgar Language
overview: Scripture commands believers to honor God's name and avoid taking it in vain, recognizing the seriousness of such speech (Exodus 20:7). It warns that careless words can bring destruction, urging restraint and thoughtful communication (Proverbs 13:3). Christians are called to reject corrupt, filthy, and foolish talk, instead using their words to build others up and minister grace (Ephesians 4:29; 5:4; Colossians 3:8). Vigilance against harmful speech is essential for spiritual health and reflects a heart transformed by Christ (Philippians 3:2).
